name: Your skin belongs to another
source:
If they looked exactly like us, how would you know? They copy everything – the voice, the gestures, the skin. It takes days, not minutes, and pain is part of the process. 

When you finally notice, it’s already too late...

[From [url=https://imwithredshirt.itch.io/your-skin-belongs-to-another]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
如果他们看起来和我们一模一样，你怎么知道？他们模仿一切——声音、手势、皮肤。这需要几天，而不是几分钟，并且痛苦是这个过程的一部分。

当你终于注意到的时候，已经太迟了……

[来自[url=https://imwithredshirt.itch.io/your-skin-belongs-to-another]Itch.io[/url]]
